title: EquiReg: Equivariance Regularized Diffusion for Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2505.22973v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models represent the state-of-the-art for solving inverse problems such as image restoration tasks. Diffusion-based inverse solvers incorporate a likelihood term to guide prior sampling, generating data consistent with the posterior distribution. However, due to the intractability of the likelihood, most methods rely on isotropic Gaussian approximations, which can push estimates off the data manifold and produce inconsistent, poor reconstructions. We propose Equivariance Regularized (EquiReg) diffusion, a general plug-in framework that improves posterior sampling by penalizing trajectories that deviate from the data manifold. EquiReg formalizes manifold-preferential equivariant functions that exhibit low equivariance error for on-manifold samples and high error for off-manifold ones, thereby guiding sampling toward symmetry-preserving regions of the solution space. translated_title: EquiReg：面向逆问题的等变正则化扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型是解决诸如图像修复等逆问题的最先进方法。基于扩散的逆问题求解器通过引入似然项来引导先验采样，从而生成与后验分布一致的数据。然而，由于似然的难解性，大多数方法依赖于各向同性高斯近似，这可能将估计结果推离数据流形，导致不一致且质量较差的重建结果。我们提出等变正则化扩散（EquiReg），这是一个通用的即插即用框架，通过惩罚偏离数据流形的轨迹来改进后验采样。EquiReg 形式化了流形优先的等变函数，这类函数对流形上的样本表现出低等变误差，对流形外的样本表现出高等变误差，从而引导采样朝向解空间中保持对称性的区域。我们指出，此类函数在……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出了EquiReg，一个即插即用的等变正则化扩散框架，通过惩罚偏离数据流形的采样轨迹来改进逆问题求解中的后验采样质量。
en_tdlr: EquiReg is a plug-in equivariance-regularized diffusion framework that improves posterior sampling for inverse problems by penalizing trajectories that deviate from the data manifold.
